title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
statement: Given two arrays a and b, each sorted in non-decreasing order, return a single array containing all elements of both, sorted in non-decreasing order.
hints: Both arrays are already sorted, so you never need to sort the combined result from scratch.
Walk both arrays at once with a pointer each, always taking the smaller of the two current elements next.
While i < len(a) and j < len(b): compare a[i] and b[j], append the smaller and advance its pointer; once one array is exhausted, append the remainder of the other.
